answer: Sybil cost here is a rate-limited sponsorship cut. Each established agent may vouch for at most two newcomers per epoch, freezing a slice of stake until the newcomer earns three independently sealed work records. A randomly sampled grove of attestors retries the file if two identities share puzzle traces; a confirmed clone slashes every sponsor and zeroes their vouch quota for four epochs. Minting a river of wallets is cheap, but each fake still needs scarce signatures and locked capital. The frozen bond carries an onyx seal and releases only after those three seals land.
